PMC Open Access Corpus
5.8 million PubMed Central clinical publications
Regex candidate extraction across case reports
Yields 250,294 raw clinical patient narratives

Clinical Eligibility Filter Gate
Single patient · post-birth diagnosis · single outcome?
Diagnostic rather than treatment-focused?
Discard ineligible records or retain 104,000 cases

Orphanet Ontology Mapping Gate
CODER embeddings retrieve top-10 candidate diseases
Does GPT-4o confirm valid Orphanet mapping?
Discard unmapped or advance 57,000 mapped cases

Clinical Task Partitioning
Branch into Screening (RDS) vs Confirmation (RDC)
RDS truncates before any diagnostic testing
RDC truncates before final diagnosis with test findings

Diagnosis Leakage Detection Gate
GPT-4o rewrite strips diagnostic clues & rationales
Detector scans names, synonyms & abbreviations
Discard leaking cases or approve release

RareArena Curated Benchmark
49,760 RDS cases across 4,597 rare diseases
22,901 RDC cases across 3,522 rare diseases
Gold-standard clinical rare disease repository

Zero-Shot Diagnostic Prompting
Input clinical narrative with temperature 0.1
Prompt model to reason across 4,000+ conditions
Output top-5 differential rare disease diagnoses

Evaluation Protocol Routing Gate
Route evaluation workflow:
Automated Top-k Diagnostic Benchmark
vs Dual-Physician Quality Audit Panel

GPT-4o Semantic Term Alignment
Compare predicted candidates against gold diagnosis
Score 2 for exact/synonym · Score 1 for hypernym
Score 0 for miss or incorrect disease entity

Top-k Diagnostic Recall Metrics
Calculate Top-1 Recall (Top prediction matches gold)
Calculate Top-5 Recall (Gold in top-5 candidates)
Report separately across RDS and RDC tracks

Dual-Physician Expert Audit
Two licensed physicians independently audit 100 cases
